interview.openTomorrow: Yeah for sure, I'd open it tomorrow. It's like a chill way to see what your friends are doing with water and stuff, kind of fun to check in
interview.secured: I think it means like your data is safe or maybe your posts are private? Like protected mode or something
interview.freeze: Probably like pausing your account or stopping tracking for a bit, like freezing your progress
interview.selfReported: That's probably when you put in your own info instead of the app tracking it automatically, like you tell it yourself
interview.best: Definitely the emoji picker part, double-tapping through all the emojis was satisfying and there's mad variety to choose from
interview.worst: The challenge itself felt kinda basic honestly, just drink water, not that interesting compared to other apps
interview.tellFriend: Yeah I'd tell them about it, I'd be like yo check out this app that tracks if you're hydrating and you can post about it to your friends with emojis, it's pretty simple but cool for a challenge
